name: ACC
query:
SELECT
    SUM(IFNULL(course_data.course_count, 0)) AS "Total Courses",
    COUNT(inv.name) AS "No of Invoices",
    ROUND((SUM(IFNULL(course_data.course_count, 0)) / COUNT(inv.name)), 2) AS "ACC"
FROM 
    (
        SELECT %(start_date)s AS `date`
        UNION
        SELECT DATE_ADD(%(start_date)s, INTERVAL n DAY) AS `date`
        FROM (
            SELECT a.N + b.N * 10 + c.N * 100 + 1 AS n
            FROM (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) AS a
            CROSS JOIN (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) AS b
            CROSS JOIN (
                SELECT 0 AS N UNION SELECT 1 UNION SELECT 2 UNION SELECT 3 UNION SELECT 4 UNION SELECT 5 UNION SELECT 6 UNION SELECT 7 UNION SELECT 8 UNION SELECT 9
            ) AS c
            ORDER BY n
        ) AS nums
        WHERE DATE_ADD(%(start_date)s, INTERVAL n DAY) < %(end_date)s
        UNION
        SELECT %(end_date)s AS `date`
    ) AS date_list
INNER JOIN `tabPOS Invoice` inv ON (
    inv.`branch` = %(branch)s
    AND inv.`docstatus` = 1
)
LEFT JOIN `tabURY Report Settings` rs ON (
    rs.`branch` = %(branch)s
)
LEFT JOIN (
    SELECT
        parent,
        COUNT(DISTINCT custom_course) AS course_count
    FROM `tabPOS Invoice Item`
    WHERE custom_course IS NOT NULL 
      AND custom_course != ''
    GROUP BY parent
) course_data ON course_data.parent = inv.name
WHERE
    (
    ((rs.`hours` IS NULL OR rs.`hours` = 0) AND inv.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
    OR (rs.`hours` > 0 AND TIMESTAMP(inv.`posting_date`, inv.`posting_time`) <= TIMESTAMP(DATE_ADD(date_list.`date`, INTERVAL 1 DAY), CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')) AND TIMESTAMP(inv.`posting_date`, inv.`posting_time`) >= TIMESTAMP(date_list.`date`, CONCAT(LPAD(rs.`hours`, 2, '0'), ':00:00')))
    OR (rs.`branch` IS NULL AND inv.`posting_date` = date_list.`date`)
    )
  AND inv.waiter IS NOT NULL 
  AND inv.waiter != ''
